title: TV news still with lower third
description: A frame grab from a local TV newscast: an AI photo (live shot or anchor) under a template-rendered lower third, LIVE bug, station bug and ticker. All readable text is in these fields, never in the photo.

station.description: Station brand for the bug (defaults to brand.aliases.localTv, then 'Channel 5')

stationShort.description: Short mark inside the station bug (number or call letters)

headline.description: Main lower-third line (all caps on air; under ~45 characters)
examples: CYBER TERROR AT NCIA: IS IT SAFE?

lowerThird.description: Second line under the headline (detail or attribution)
examples: Screens show 'Flight 666 to Purgatory'; baggage system reportedly down

liveBadge.description: Show the LIVE bug in the top-left corner

temperature.description: Weather temperature next to the clock

nameSuper.description: Name of the reporter or interviewee shown on the lower third

ticker.description: Crawl text along the bottom (several items separated by ' • ')
examples: FAA: Air traffic control operating normally • Travelers urged to check airline apps

anchorBrief.description: Image-generation brief for the photo slot (reporter live shot, anchor desk or b-roll). Media stage only; not rendered.
examples: field reporter with microphone in a crowded airport terminal, broadcast camera footage
